name: Best Buy Web Scraper
description: Best Buy web scraper for Python and the command line: Best Buy's own current price for a list of SKUs or product URLs, with regular price, sale flag, stock status, seller, UPC, model and category, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: product
commands.help: Best Buy's current price, stock and seller for SKUs
commands.description: Best Buy's own current price for a list of SKUs — regular price, stock, seller, UPC.

inputs.name: products
inputs.description: Best Buy product URLs or SKUs (one per line).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many products to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered products.
